## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A single-*juan* Southern-Sòng compilation by **Luóxī Yuánwù** 螺溪元悟 of materials documenting the Tiāntáishān **Luóxī Chuánjiàoyuàn** 螺溪傳教院 patriarchal lineage — the same institutional context at which Goryeo [諦觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E8%AB%A6%E8%A7%80) Dìguān had transmitted the recovered Tiāntái texts back to China. Companion to Zōngxiǎo's parallel *Bǎoyún zhènzǔ jí* ([KR6d0222](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6d/KR6d0222)).

**Abstract**

The composition is bracketed within Yuánwù's productive period in the Southern Sòng (c. 1150–1250).
